title: Constructing a limit model and developing an HPLC-MS/MS analytical method for measuring isothiazolinone migration from children's sports protectors into sweat
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,17972-17985
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08953G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Baohua Mai, Zhenhai Zhu, Fei Xie, Caiding Ouyang, Mei Wei, Huiling Qiu, Lezhou Yi, Tongmei Ma, Lina Huang
This study established a sweat migration model for three isothiazolinones in children's sports protectors and derived their migration limit values. Finally, a set of HPLC-MS/MS analytical methods was developed for these three isothiazolinones.
